messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: HIGH_SEVERITY: GPU_POOL_THROTTLE in region us-west-2 detected at 2026-03-15T11:13:19Z. Symptoms: sustained queue growth, increased 429s on /v1/generate, autoscaler failed to allocate additional GPUs.
lee-oncall: Im on it. first pass: which pools and which model routes are impacted?
tara-sre: gpu-prod-usw2 standard & spot pools both reporting long queues. Current queue depth ~12.4k; error rate 429 ~11k in last 20m. p99 latency > 200s for some routes.
devin-ml: top affected route is /v1/chat/stream-large (40% of failing calls). Also seeing elevated token generation timeouts on smaller models when queued.
arun-platform: autoscaler logs show repeated provider rejections: "API_QUOTA_LIMIT" returned on instance create. Backoff kicked in and prevented further immediate retries.
emma-support: two enterprise customers opened tickets complaining of timeouts. Collecting request ids now.
klaus-eng: confirming we rolled a change to autoscaler backoff last week (widen backoff to reduce flapping). Might have inadvertently prevented recovery when provider briefly allowed new capacity.
lee-oncall: immediate mitigation playbook (parallelize):
- apply short-term rate-limits to unauthenticated & free-tier tokens
- enable degraded-serving mode for large chat models (serve smaller context/approx models)
- drain/evict non-critical batch jobs
- attempt cross-region spill to eu-central-1 for new sessions
- open support case with cloud provider for quota bump (priority: business-impact)
tara-sre: executing throttle now. PATCH to rate-limiter: 
```
PATCH /config/ratelimit
{ "classes": ["free-tier", "anonymous"], "global_limit_per_key": "15r/s" }
```
Applied to edge fleet in 30s.
tara-sre: anonymous+free-tier ingress down ~58%; queue dropped to ~5.4k within 9m.
devin-ml: enabling degraded-serving for /v1/chat/stream-large: mapping requests to lite-model-variant. Expect lower quality for some prompts but far lower compute. Pushing config now.
klaus-eng: routing change done: new sessions for specified models will prefer eu-central-1 if warm nodes available. Added note: some model variants not mirrored cross-region; those will still queue.
arun-platform: opened provider ticket: CS-1001222. Provider acknowledged, says quota limit on GPU family G5 in us-west-2; asked for justification; estimated time to quota increase ~45-90m. Requested expedite.
infra-bot: metric snapshot: queue=5200, 429_rate decreased 70% from peak, 5xx steady at 0.4%.
emma-support: customers notified with preliminary update. Asking for follow-up timeline and mitigation steps were taking.
lee-oncall: good. secondary mitigation: spin up 6 warm nodes in eu-central warmpool and flip 30% of new traffic there. klaus, can you allocate?
klaus-eng: allocating warmpool-euc-6 -> promoting to hot. ETA 6m.
klaus-eng: nodes up, start routing ~28% new sessions to eu-central-1. Monitoring egress.
tara-sre: queue now ~800 after 28m since throttle + cross-region. 429s down to baseline. p95 latency still ~18s due to backlog.
arun-platform: provider updated CS-1001222: expedited quota increase approved for +64 GPUs, provisioning in progress. ETA ~20m.
devin-ml: note: some customer requests hit degraded variants - we should add a flag in responses so clients know they were served in degraded mode for transparency. I'll draft a small header: "X-Redwood-Degraded: true".;
lee-oncall: good idea. emma, please include in customer comms.
emma-support: will add note to messages.
lee-oncall: monitoring target to declare incident stabilized: queue < 200 and error rate < 0.5% for 15 consecutive minutes.
tara-sre: current queue 170, 429s nearly zero, 5xx ~ 2 in last 15m.
arun-platform: provider confirmed new nodes active; pool capacity back to nominal. CS-1001222 closed with note.
lee-oncall: transitioning to recovery phase. keep throttles for another 30m, then gradually remove.
klaus-eng: autoscaler config diff that might have contributed (recent PR): 
```
- max_nodes: 150
+ max_nodes: 240
- retry_window_ms: 20000
+ retry_window_ms: 90000
```
We increased max_nodes but also extended retry_window during provider errors; that apparently made us slower to retry when quota briefly freed. Will open PR to add a quota-error-specific override.
devin-ml: root-cause hypothesis: provider quota + autoscaler backoff policy interacting -> prevented fast ramp when provider allowed partial capacity. Secondary factors: no fast fallback routing and lack of per-tenant throttles.
lee-oncall: action items being tracked:
- (owner: klaus-eng) Add quota-failure circuit breaker to autoscaler so it will do limited retries and then fast-fail to fallback routing. (ETA 48h)
- (owner: arun-platform) Add provider quota monitors & alerting when available GPUs drop below threshold. (ETA 72h)
- (owner: tara-sre) Add a playbook step to automatically enable degraded-serving and cross-region spill after X% queue growth. (ETA 7 days)
- (owner: devin-ml) Add response header when degraded models used; update docs. (ETA 24h)
- (owner: emma-support) Draft customer-facing post-incident summary and send to affected accounts. (ETA 6h)
- (owner: lee-oncall) Lead RCA and postmortem doc. (ETA 72h)
emma-support: sent customer follow-up with incident summary + mitigations.
arun-platform: uploading logs+traces to s3: s3://incidents/2412409999/trace.tar.gz
lee-oncall: incident resolved and page closed at 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z. I'll schedule a postmortem meeting for 48h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
